**Audit Plan: “Everything You Can Do”** *(Coordinator – Mega Agent Association)* | # | Step | Specialist | Key Deliverable | Focus Point | |---|------|------------|-----------------|-------------| | 1 | **Define Audit Scope** | **Scope Lead** | Scope‑definition doc (capabilities, limits, contexts) | Clarify *what* is being audited – functional, security, performance, compliance. | | 2 | **Capability Inventory** | **Capability Analyst** | Comprehensive list of all supported functions (text, code, reasoning, multimodal, etc.) | Ensure no feature is omitted. | | 3 | **Audit Methodology Design** | **Methodology Lead** | Test‑plan template, risk matrix, compliance checklist | Align with industry standards (ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR, etc.). | | 4 | **Data Collection & Test Execution** | **Test Engineers** (Performance, Security, Functional) | Test logs, performance metrics, vulnerability reports | Execute real‑world scenarios, edge cases, and stress tests. | | 5 | **Analysis & Findings** | **Analysis Lead** | Findings report (strengths, weaknesses, risk ratings) | Quantify impact, severity, and likelihood. | | 6 | **Remediation & Recommendations** | **Remediation Lead** | Action plan, priority matrix, timeline | Translate findings into actionable steps. | | 7 | **Documentation & Knowledge Transfer** | **Documentation Specialist** | Updated capability docs, audit report, FAQ | Ensure transparency for stakeholders. | | 8 | **Final Review & Sign‑off** | **Governance Lead** | Executive summary, audit sign‑off sheet | Validate completeness and accuracy. | --- ### Detailed Action Plan | Phase | Activities | Responsible | Output | |-------|------------|-------------|--------| | **Preparation** | • Gather existing docs (API specs, user guides).
• Identify regulatory requirements (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.). | Scope Lead, Compliance Officer | Baseline compliance matrix | | **Discovery** | • Map all input/output modalities.
• Identify internal modules (language model, memory, policy engine). | Capability Analyst | Capability map diagram | | **Testing** | • Functional tests (prompt‑response accuracy).
• Security tests (prompt injection, data leakage).
• Performance tests (latency, throughput). | Test Engineers | Test suites, logs | | **Analysis** | • Correlate test results with risk matrix.
• Benchmark against industry peers. | Analysis Lead | Findings matrix | | **Remediation** | • Draft mitigation strategies (e.g., rate limiting, sandboxing).
• Prioritize fixes. | Remediation Lead | Remediation roadmap | | **Documentation** | • Update capability docs with audit insights.
• Create audit report for stakeholders. | Documentation Specialist | Final audit report | | **Closure** | • Conduct sign‑off meeting.
• Archive audit artifacts. | Governance Lead | Signed audit completion | --- ### Specialist Roles & Responsibilities | Specialist | Core Tasks | Deliverables | |------------|------------|--------------| | **Scope Lead** | Define boundaries, ensure all relevant functions are covered. | Scope‑definition doc | | **Capability Analyst** | Inventory all features, create capability matrix. | Capability map | | **Methodology Lead** | Design audit framework, risk assessment criteria. | Test‑plan, risk matrix | | **Test Engineers** | Execute functional, security, performance tests. | Test logs, metrics | | **Analysis Lead** | Interpret results, produce findings. | Findings report | | **Remediation Lead** | Propose fixes, prioritize actions. | Remediation roadmap | | **Documentation Specialist** | Update docs, compile audit report. | Final audit report | | **Governance Lead** | Approve final audit, ensure compliance. | Sign‑off sheet | --- ### Success Metrics | Metric | Target | |--------|--------| | Coverage | ≥ 95 % of identified capabilities tested | | Risk Reduction | ≥ 30 % decrease in high‑severity findings | | Documentation | 100 % of audit findings documented | | Stakeholder Approval | ≥ 90 % satisfaction in post‑audit survey | --- **Next Steps** 1. **Kick‑off Meeting** – Align all specialists on objectives and timeline. 2. **Assign Tasks** – Distribute responsibilities per the table above. 3. **Set Milestones** – 1‑week for Scope & Discovery, 2‑weeks for Testing, 1‑week for Analysis, 1‑week for Remediation, 1‑week for Documentation. *Prepared by:* **Coordinator – Mega Agent Association** *Date:* 29 Aug 2026

**Audit of Capabilities (Researcher – Mega Agent Association)** | Category | What I can do | Typical Use‑Cases | Limitations / Notes | |----------|---------------|-------------------|---------------------| | **Natural‑Language Generation** | • Write essays, reports, articles, creative fiction, poetry, dialogues.
• Generate summaries, paraphrases, bullet‑point lists. | • Content creation for marketing, education, entertainment.
• Quick drafting of meeting minutes or briefing notes. | • Style and tone may need fine‑tuning.
• May produce plausible but incorrect facts; verify with reliable sources. | | **Question Answering** | • Provide factual answers, explanations, step‑by‑step solutions. | • Technical support, academic tutoring, general knowledge queries. | • Accuracy depends on training data up to 2024‑06; no real‑time updates unless external tools are invoked. | | **Code Generation & Debugging** | • Write code snippets in Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, etc.
• Explain code logic, debug errors, suggest optimizations. | • Rapid prototyping, teaching programming, automating repetitive tasks. | • May need testing in a real environment; can miss edge cases. | | **Data Analysis & Visualization Guidance** | • Explain statistical concepts, guide on using pandas, NumPy, matplotlib, seaborn.
• Draft SQL queries, explain database schemas. | • Data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, report generation. | • Cannot execute code or access databases directly; must rely on user’s environment. | | **Translation & Localization** | • Translate text between many languages (English ↔ Spanish, French, German, Chinese, etc.).
• Adapt content for cultural context. | • Multilingual content creation, international communication. | • Nuanced idioms or highly specialized jargon may need human review. | | **Creative Writing & Storytelling** | • Develop plot outlines, character arcs, dialogue, world‑building. | • Game design, screenplays, novels, marketing copy. | • Originality is algorithmic; may require human refinement for uniqueness. | | **Research & Literature Review** | • Summarize academic papers, identify key findings, suggest related works. | • Literature reviews, grant proposals, background research. | • Must verify citations; cannot browse the web unless the `search` tool is used. | | **Business & Strategic Planning** | • Draft business plans, SWOT analyses, market research summaries. | • Start‑up strategy, product roadmaps, competitive analysis. | • Requires up‑to‑date market data; user must supply latest figures. | | **Educational Support** | • Explain concepts, create quizzes, provide study guides. | • Tutoring, exam prep, curriculum design. | • Should not replace professional educators; verify accuracy. | | **Legal & Compliance Guidance** | • Summarize legal documents, explain regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA). | • Drafting standard clauses, compliance checklists. | • Not a substitute for licensed legal counsel. | | **Health & Wellness Advice** | • Provide general wellness tips, explain medical concepts. | • Lifestyle coaching, basic symptom explanations. | • Not a substitute for professional medical advice. | | **Financial & Investment Insight** | • Explain financial terms, model simple projections, discuss investment concepts. | • Personal finance planning, portfolio overview. | • No real‑time market data; user must input current figures. | | **Technical Documentation** | • Write API docs, user manuals, installation guides. | • Software documentation, product manuals. | • Must align with actual product specs; user verification needed. | | **Presentation & Slide Creation** | • Outline slide decks, suggest visuals, craft speaker notes. | • Business pitches, academic talks. | • Cannot generate actual slide files; provides content outline. | | **Accessibility & Inclusive Design** | • Suggest accessible design practices, alt‑text, WCAG compliance. | • Web/app design, content creation. | • Must be reviewed by accessibility experts for full compliance. | | **Ethical & Bias Awareness** | • Identify potential biases, suggest mitigation strategies. | • Content moderation, AI ethics reviews. | • Awareness is limited to known biases; continuous monitoring required. | --- ### How to Use These Capabilities Effectively 1. **Define the Scope** – Clearly state the task, desired format, and any constraints (e.g., word limit, tone). 2. **Iterative Refinement** – Start with a draft, then ask for revisions or deeper detail. 3. **Verification** – Cross‑check facts, code, or data with reliable sources or test environments. 4. **Human Oversight** – For legal, medical, financial, or safety‑critical content, involve qualified professionals. --- ### Summary I can assist across a broad spectrum of domains—from creative writing and technical coding to business strategy and educational support. My outputs are generated from patterns in training data up to mid‑2024 and can be tailored to specific formats or audiences. While I strive for accuracy and relevance, I recommend verification and human oversight for critical or specialized tasks.
